## Testing

Describe how you tested the changes.

### Required checks

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:rules` if Firebase security rules were changed
- [ ] Relevant functionality was tested manually
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for visual changes at 1280px and 390px

## Definition of Done

- [ ] This PR contains one clear topic or change
- [ ] The code builds successfully
- [ ] Linting and type checking pass
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass
- [ ] The change has been tested locally
- [ ] Visual changes match the supplied design/reference screenshots
- [ ] Responsive changes were checked at the required widths
- [ ] Existing shared components and helpers are reused where appropriate
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, credentials, or `.env` files were committed
- [ ] No unnecessary `console.log` statements remain
- [ ] Documentation was updated if setup or behaviour changed
